latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Fedica skill for cross-platform social post scheduling.

- Compose and schedule posts on X, LinkedIn, Threads, Mastodon, and Bluesky via agent-browser.
- Handles login workflows, image upload (modal-based), scheduling (UTC-only display), and character limits for each platform.
- Provides safety guidelines, key workflow steps, and solutions to common issues.
- Details essential gotchas, including platform-specific constraints and UI elements.
- Supports verification and editing of scheduled posts through agent-browser commands.
